attr.title: Moonstone Remake
attr.desc: An unofficial, work-in-progress native remake of Moonstone: A Hard Day's Knight (1991). Explore the map, battle monsters and rival knights, collect equipment and complete the quest. Experimental ARM64 build; RG40XX H with muOS is the tested hardware baseline. Original game data is required.
attr.inst: Requires your own supported retail IPF disks, named Moonstone_DiskA.ipf, Moonstone_DiskB.ipf and Moonstone_DiskC.ipf, in moonstone/disks/. First launch converts them locally. Alternatively copy a generated content/current.json and its classic-v1-<checksum> folder into moonstone/content/. Install Godot 4.6.3 and Westonpack 0.2 with PortMaster. Allow 1 GB free for conversion. See moonstone/README.txt for installation, muOS paths, controls and troubleshooting.
